en: AI Eats the Value Chain: How AI Products Displace Cognitive Labor, Not Just Competitors
zh: AI 吞噬价值链：从"信息检索"到"认知代办"的产品替代规律

excerpts.zh: AI 替代的不只是一个 App，而是用户原来的一整套信息加工行为。
excerpts.en: AI replaces not just an app, but the information work people used to do.

excerpts.zh: 综合信息这一步正在从人转移给 AI。
excerpts.en: Synthesizing information is moving from people to AI.

excerpts.zh: 把十篇文章压缩成几百字，即使没有错误，也会丢失细节。
excerpts.en: Even an accurate summary of ten articles loses detail.

excerpts.zh: 解释偏差、融合偏差和幻觉，是不同的产品设计问题。
excerpts.en: Interpretation bias, synthesis bias and hallucination need different design responses.

excerpts.zh: 有些任务需要一个足够好的答案，有些任务需要不断修正理解。
excerpts.en: Some tasks need a good enough answer; others need an evolving understanding.

excerpts.zh: 发散型任务中，对话的过程本身就有价值。
excerpts.en: In exploratory tasks, the conversation itself has value.

excerpts.zh: 分析 AI 产品时，可以先问：它替用户做掉了哪部分认知劳动？
excerpts.en: To analyze an AI product, ask which cognitive work it takes over.

excerpts.zh: 当规划被自动化，真人体验仍然可能成为判断的依据。
excerpts.en: When planning is automated, first-hand experience can still support judgment.

excerpts.zh: 知识管理工具可能从存储知识，转向支持思考。
excerpts.en: Knowledge tools may shift from storing information to supporting thought.

excerpts.zh: 生成演示文稿变容易后，想清楚要讲什么仍然重要。
excerpts.en: When making slides gets easier, deciding what to say still matters.

excerpts.zh: 提出目标、承担责任和价值判断，并不会随信息处理自动化而消失。
excerpts.en: Goals, responsibility and value judgments do not disappear when information processing is automated.

excerpts.zh: 下一代产品也许需要比较：谁能帮助人形成更好的判断？
excerpts.en: The next product question may be: who helps people make better judgments?
